content: Classic Stripe race condition: two concurrent requests both search for a customer by email, both find none, both create a customer -> duplicate customers. stripe-node issue #476 confirms this is a known unsolved gap in the API itself (no native upsert-by-email). Recommended fix is a DB-level UNIQUE constraint (e.g. on stripe_customer_id or on the linking key) so only one concurrent writer wins and the other catches a constraint violation and retries by re-reading. For webhooks specifically: events are at-least-once and unordered, so idempotency must be enforced via a UNIQUE constraint on event.id in your own DB, and webhook handlers should only verify+enqueue, not synchronously write business state, to avoid the eager-sync race entirely.
